subject: Initial MAP kickoff — goals, owners, and timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP kickoff — goals, owners, and timeline

Hi Samira —

Great to meet you over the demo last week. I wanted to get our mutual action plan (MAP) started so we have clear owners, success criteria, and a target close date. Proposed high-level plan below (attached is a working MAP template so we can track tasks):

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for secure, low-latency clinical summary generation in our pilot clinic workflows.
- Primary success metric: average generation latency < 600ms and PHI-safe extraction accuracy > 95% on our test set.
- Target pilot start: week of Aug 18, 2025
- Target decision/close: week of Oct 6, 2025 (8-week evaluation window)

Proposed milestones / owners (first pass):
1) Kickoff & access (this week): Helix – Samira (champion); Redwood – me (AE) & Marissa (CSM)
2) Security & compliance review (1–2 weeks): Helix security team; Redwood security (Priyom)
3) Sandbox access & sample dataset upload (2 weeks): Helix engineering; Redwood infra team
4) Evaluation run (4 weeks): joint ops; regular quality checks
5) Decision & procurement (final week): procurement/legal

Action items for this email:
- Samira: confirm the champion and whether your security reviewer needs any specific artifacts we should prioritize (SOC 2, data handling docs).
- Charlie (cc'd): please confirm your primary technical contact for the sandbox.
- Marissa/Priyom: I’ve attached the MAP template and SOC2 questionnaire draft — Priyom can pick up the security thread after Samira confirms.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32 KB)]

If this looks good I’ll update the MAP and share a Kickoff calendar invite for Wed 7/2 at 10am PT.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helixhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Charlie Vega <charlie.vega@helixhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP kickoff — goals, owners, and timeline

Thanks Karthik — this is exactly what I was hoping for. I can confirm I’ll be the champion and I’ve looped in Charlie (engineering) who will be our technical lead. A few quick notes from our side:

- Timeline: can we stretch the evaluation to 10 weeks instead of 8? Our compliance window and executive reviews typically take a bit longer in July (lots of people on vacation). If we push target decision to Oct 20 that gives us more runway.
- Security: our security team prefers doc-level answers for the SOC 2 questions; I see you attached the questionnaire — could Priyom complete the vendor section and send back?
- Sandbox data: we’ll prepare a de-identified sample set; Charlie will share a S3 write role for the upload.

Attachments: [Attachment: Helix_Security_Primer.pdf (stub)]

I’m available for the kickoff on Wed 7/2 at 10am PT but if we move the timeline I’m flexible to shift.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director of Clinical Programs | Helix Health
samira.khan@helixhealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Charlie Vega <charlie.vega@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP kickoff — goals, owners, and timeline

Thanks Samira — good call on the extra runway. Updated plan below with your suggested decision week: Oct 20 (10-week evaluation). I’ll update the shared MAP and send a revised invite once we lock the kickoff.

Updated milestone dates (first pass):
- Week 0 (Kickoff): access & roles confirmed
- Weeks 1–2: security questionnaire + artifact exchange (Priyom will own vendor responses)
- Weeks 3–4: sandbox provisioning + dataset ingestion
- Weeks 5–10: evaluation and weekly checkpoints (Marissa will run weekly ops reviews)
- Week 11 (Oct 20): decision review with execs

Priyom — can you take the SOC 2 vendor section and send the completed PDF to Samira and security@helixhealth.com by EOD Thu 7/3?
Charlie — can you share the name/email of your S3 upload owner so we can grant the temporary role?

I’ll attach the updated MAP once I make these date adjustments.

On Mon, 30 Jun 2025 at 09:47, Samira Khan <samira.khan@helixhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Karthik — this is exactly what I was hoping for. I can confirm I’ll be the champion...

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helixhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Charlie Vega <charlie.vega@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP kickoff — goals, owners, and timeline

Hi Samira — welcome, and thanks Karthik for pulling this together. I’ll be your Customer Success lead for the evaluation. Quick operational notes from my side:

- Weekly checkpoints: I’ll schedule 30-minute syncs every Wednesday at 9am PT starting 7/16 to review quality, latency, and any blocker tickets.
- Test harness: we’ll provide a lightweight runner for your sample dataset so metrics are comparable week-to-week.
- Communication: please share a primary technical contact (email) and snack preferences are not required but appreciated.

Priyom — ping me when you’ve returned the SOC 2 section; I’ll add it to the MAP under "security sign-off".

Looking forward to working with you all — I’ll send the weekly cadence invite once we confirm the kickoff date.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0199
